before: The review pane opened itself on load and on the first tracked change. scrollToBlock always put the block near the top. A picker or the toolbar overflow panel opened by a click ignored Escape, or let the surface spend the key first. A reply avatar took the thread author's colour.
after: Review pane settings, opening ('auto' or 'manual') and overflow ('float' or 'shrinkPage'), come from reviewModule({ pane }) and change at runtime through setReviewPaneOptions; snapshot.reviewPane reads them. scrollToBlock takes the scrollToAnchor options. Escape closes an open toolbar picker or overflow panel before the surface handles header, footer, note, or format painter mode. A reply in a review card draws in its own author's colour. A press on a control a host adds inside a review card no longer refocuses or activates the card. getReviewItemsAt and getReviewItemRects read review items and current layout geometry without changing the document. getReviewItems({ pairReplacements: true }) lists a deletion and the touching insertion after it as one replacement; accepting or rejecting it resolves both halves with the same revision operations a host issues for each half, in one transaction. The compact review card renders the same card template as the review list.
reason: Pane settings, pane visibility, scroll position, and popup state are local view state of one editor instance; they are never saved or shared. No shared document state or operation changes. The review hit test reads the review queue and the layout only. Replacement pairing is a read of the review queue; resolving a pair commits the existing acceptRevision and rejectRevision operations, which two-participant tests cover for synchronization, undo, redo, rejoin, and concurrent edits. The compact card template is local view state.
